intent: New paradigm focus signature cards, queued with existing matching art as a fallback.
shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE Rootward fantasy programming roguelite card icon. Style: polished high-resolution fantasy pixel art, matching the finished bronze-and-jewel icons. Bold dark plum contours, rich bronze fittings, broad cyan/amber/violet crystal planes, restrained ivory highlights, crisp stepped edges and large readable clusters. Design with roughly 128-pixel detail density, NOT an enlarged crude 32-pixel placeholder. Compact SQUARE composition, the single icon centred and filling 82 percent of both width and height, with transparent margins. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No words, letters, numerals, UI, decorative outer frame, scenery, ground, fake checkerboard, haze, tiny wires or particles. Subject:

activity-selection.summary: Sorts foes by intent tempo and sends the strongest bolts until each falls. Quick attackers come first.

activity-selection-plus.summary: Sorts foes by intent tempo; ties favour the greater intended damage. Sends the strongest bolts until each falls.

first-fit-decreasing.summary: Strongest bolts first: packs each into the first foe it overkills by at most 2. Leftovers aim at the front.

first-fit-decreasing-plus.summary: Strongest bolts first: packs each into the first foe it overkills by at most 1. Leftovers aim at the front.

cartesian-product.summary: Every bolt-foe pair makes a new bolt of half power, aimed at that foe.

cartesian-product-plus.summary: Every bolt-foe pair makes a new bolt of half power, aimed at that foe. Costs 1 mana.

nested-strike.summary: For each foe, fires the whole volley at full power until that foe falls. Bolts can strike each foe.

nested-strike-plus.summary: For each foe, fires the whole volley at full power until that foe falls. Costs 1 mana.

memo-strike.summary: Aims at the foe hit most this fight. Each bolt gains 1 per earlier hit, up to 4.

memo-strike-plus.summary: Aims at the foe hit most this fight. Each bolt gains 1 per earlier hit, up to 6.

recurrence.summary: From turn 2, appends a bolt of half the sum of the last two DP rows. Missing rows count as zero.

recurrence-plus.summary: From turn 2, appends a bolt of the sum of the last two DP rows plus one third. Missing rows count as zero.

base-case.summary: Doubles every bolt when the volley has at most 2 bolts. Recurse makes small halves reach this base case.

base-case-plus.summary: Doubles every bolt when the volley has at most 3 bolts. Recurse makes small halves reach this base case.

top-k.summary: A bounded min-heap keeps the four strongest bolts; discarded power fuses into the weakest survivor.

top-k-plus.summary: A bounded min-heap keeps the five strongest bolts; discarded power fuses into the weakest survivor.

lookup.summary: Binary-searches the index for the smallest bolt that kills the front foe; otherwise takes its strongest.

lookup-plus.summary: Binary-searches the index twice for bolts that kill the front foe; otherwise takes the strongest remaining.

two-sum.summary: A hash map finds two bolts summing to the front foe's HP; they fuse. Otherwise its two strongest aim there.

two-sum-plus.summary: A hash map finds two bolts summing to each of the first two foes' HP; exact pairs fuse. Otherwise the two strongest aim there.

coin-change.summary: A 0/1 DP table finds the fewest bolts summing exactly to the front foe's HP. The rest aim at the next foe.

coin-change-plus.summary: A 0/1 DP table finds the fewest bolts summing exactly to the first two foes' HP in turn. Bolts are used only once.

backtracking.summary: Backtracks over assignments to all foes for the most kills. Prunes branches that cannot improve the best; up to 12 bolts, m choices per bolt.

backtracking-plus.summary: Backtracks over assignments to all foes for the most kills, then least overkill. Also prunes already beaten foes; up to 12 bolts.

interpolation-search.summary: On a sorted volley, estimates where each foe's killing bolt lies from its power. Uses the strongest if none kills.

interpolation-search-plus.summary: On a sorted volley, estimates each killing bolt's position; falls back to binary search after a poor guess.

k-way-merge.summary: Finds rising runs and heap-merges them weakest first. Every bolt gains 1 per run.

k-way-merge-plus.summary: Finds rising runs and heap-merges them. Every bolt gains 1 per run; the code chooses strongest first.

dutch-flag.summary: Three-way partitions around the front foe's HP: exact bolts first, stronger next, weaker last. Exact bolts are pivots.

dutch-flag-plus.summary: Three-way partitions around the front foe's HP: exact bolts first, stronger next, weaker last. Exact pivots gain 1.
